page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7a.16xlarge demonstrates strong performance in CPU-intensive and memory-bound tasks. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, as well as Passmark CPU encryption and extended instruction tests. Memory performance is highly efficient for cached small-block reads, though uncached large-block read and write operations fall into the average range. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, ray tracing, and image processing also show strong execution speeds, while database operations, Redis SET throughput, and static web serving remain average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated CPU cores and memory, making it a viable option for workloads requiring significant RAM without the overhead of local storage. However, the lack of bundled local SSDs and GPUs represents a tradeoff for applications requiring high-speed local caching or hardware-accelerated parallel processing. The ecs.r7a.16xlarge is well-suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale caching layers, in-memory databases, multi-threaded data processing, and small-model LLM inference tasks.
